connections.description: A list of NAT traversal connections to establish. Each item is a map describing one side of a tunnel.

connections.items.name.description: Human-readable name for the connection entry, used for comment identification only.

connections.items.local_port.description: The local UDP port to use for the connection.

connections.items.peer_nat_gateway.description: The IP address or hostname of the NAT gateway of the remote host.

connections.items.remote_port.description: The UDP port on the remote host that nat-traverse is listening on.

connections.items.cmd.description: Command to run after establishing the connection (e.g., pppd or nc). Empty string disables command execution.

connections.items.window.description: Number of initial garbage packets to send. Default 10 works with most firewalls.

connections.items.timeout.description: Maximum seconds to wait for an acknowledgement by the peer.

connections.items.quit_after_connect.description: If true, quits nat-traverse after the tunnel is established successfully. Useful for chaining with other services like OpenVPN.
